meta.title: Prompt boost
meta.description: Adds a persona-aware enhance-prompt button to the composer tool row: pick a persona (product, engineering, ops, data, design, marketing, content, project, finance, sales, legal, training, custom, or auto), and the draft is rewritten in that seat's habits. Only the persona and task constraints are used — never your name, company or job title; the constraints stay in this browser, and one click reverts.

title: Enhance prompt
revertHint: Restore the draft from before the enhancement
personaHint: What this request needs, not just how it is worded
contextHint: Task facts only: budget, platform, length, deadline. No name, company or job title — those never reach the result. Stored in this browser only.
